periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented approximately 45 degrees downward and inward toward the muzzle relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with a vertical axis approximately 1.6 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward taper observed where the inferior terminus is significantly further from the centroid than the superior terminus.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The horizontal gap between the medial edges of the pinnae is approximately 1.8 times the width of an individual pinna base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded convex apex on the viewer-right pinna; viewer-left pinna shows a slightly more acute, less rounded profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced sagittal crest fur peak forming a vertical ridge at the cranial midline.
